opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Low‑income households, ordinarily resident in Scotland, not eligible for other tuition fee support, UK indefinite leave or asylum seeker, must have an unconditional offer for a full‑time, part‑time or distance learning undergraduate degree for academic year 2026‑27 at a Scottish higher education institution.
opportunities.summary: Supports students enrolled on an undergraduate degree course at a Scottish Institute of Higher Education who are not eligible for government tuition fee funding, covering tuition fees up to £1,820 per year.
